Q1: Which branch should the updated test expectation land on?
Choices:
A. On PR #6849's head branch `ai/issue-6838`, so the test and the new auto-approval step land together. The fix PR targets `ai/issue-6838`, or the commit goes straight onto PR #6849. (RECOMMENDED)
B. On `main`, held until PR #6849 merges, then changed from 4 to 5. PR #6849's CI stays red until then.
C. On `main` now, with the test accepting either 4 or 5 declarations for `plan.yml`. This weakens the exact-count check the test exists to enforce.
